column1: # main sets a 4.94 GB heap (SetHeapSize 0x13be00000 with the 9 GB pool) and uses it without checking the result, so the heap region (block - 256 MB - alias - stack) must hold it
# the game asked for a 4.94 GB heap: a 5.000 GB heap region beside a 4.375 GB alias region
# heap check: 2026-11-14, the heap request did not fit; set mem_reserve
# address regions: 2026-11-14, in its first 15 s in nnMain the game's regions reach alias +2.09 GB, within the profile's 4.38 GB alias region (on the phone, +3.25 GB in a course)
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (spec: Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# conditional clears evaluated at replay: without them the half-resolution depth and occlusion targets are wiped between their draws, the occlusion mask goes black and the
# program 0's groups (dm/games/010015100B514000): its shaders are where program 0's are, in the RomFS it reads (conorig) and in the add-on's Shader/, Effect/ and Layout/
